title: Sequence Transformation
statementMd:
You've got a non-decreasing sequence $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ ... ≤ *x*_{*n*} ≤ *q*)$. You've also got two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ $(*a* ≤ *b*; *a*·(*n* - 1) < *q*)$.

Your task is to transform sequence $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ into some sequence $*y*_{1}, *y*_{2}, ..., *y*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *q*; *a* ≤ *y*_{*i* + 1} - *y*_{*i*} ≤ *b*)$. The transformation price is the following sum: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2932f339c0d0f43caa55ecad28d2426256d02ff5.png). Your task is to choose such sequence $*y*$ that minimizes the described transformation price.

## Input

The first line contains four integers $*n*, *q*, *a*, *b*$ $(2 ≤ *n* ≤ 6000; 1 ≤ *q*, *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{9}; *a*·(*n* - 1) < *q*; *a* ≤ *b*)$.

The second line contains a non-decreasing integer sequence $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ ... ≤ *x*_{*n*} ≤ *q*)$.

## Output

In the first line print $*n*$ real numbers — the sought sequence $*y*_{1}, *y*_{2}, ..., *y*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *q*; *a* ≤ *y*_{*i* + 1} - *y*_{*i*} ≤ *b*)$. In the second line print the minimum transformation price, that is, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2932f339c0d0f43caa55ecad28d2426256d02ff5.png).

If there are multiple optimal answers you can print any of them.

The answer will be considered correct if the absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 6}$.
statementZhMd:
你有一个非递减序列 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ ... ≤ *x*_{*n*} ≤ *q*)$。此外，还有两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ $(*a* ≤ *b*; *a*·(*n* - 1) < *q*)$。

你的任务是将序列 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ 变换为某个序列 $*y*_{1}, *y*_{2}, ..., *y*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *q*; *a* ≤ *y*_{*i* + 1} - *y*_{*i*} ≤ *b*)$。变换代价定义为以下总和：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2932f339c0d0f43caa55ecad28d2426256d02ff5.png)。你的任务是选择这样的序列 $*y*$，使上述变换代价最小。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*n*, *q*, *a*, *b*$ $(2 ≤ *n* ≤ 6000; 1 ≤ *q*, *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{9}; *a*·(*n* - 1) < *q*; *a* ≤ *b*)$。

第二行包含一个非递减整数序列 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ ... ≤ *x*_{*n*} ≤ *q*)$。

## 输出格式

第一行输出 $*n*$ 个实数，即所求序列 $*y*_{1}, *y*_{2}, ..., *y*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *q*; *a* ≤ *y*_{*i* + 1} - *y*_{*i*} ≤ *b*)$。第二行输出最小变换代价，即 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2932f339c0d0f43caa55ecad28d2426256d02ff5.png)。

如果有多个最优答案，输出其中任意一个即可。

如果绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则答案将被视为正确。
